news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Upgraded by Wall Street Zen to "Hold" Rating
news.summary: Wall Street Zen's quant model moved uniQure back to Hold after briefly rating it Sell in early August, though most sell-side analysts remain far more bullish with a Strong Buy consensus.

news.headline: uniQure N.V. (NASDAQ:QURE) Receives $65.00 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: A roundup of covering brokerages put uniQure's average price target at $65, implying substantial upside from the then-prevailing share price and reflecting continued Street optimism on AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its uniQure price target to $75 from $60 and kept an Overweight rating following the company's Q2 2026 results and reaffirmed AMT-130 regulatory timeline.

news.headline: Barclays Maintains uniQure (QURE) Rating, Lowers Price Target
news.summary: Barclays trimmed its uniQure price target to $60 from $65 while keeping an Overweight rating, a modest post-earnings recalibration rather than a change in stance.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 revenue of $5.8 million and $810.3 million in cash (runway into 2030) after its June $259 million raise, and confirmed that written FDA meeting minutes received in July support an AMT-130 accelerated-approval BLA filing in Q3 2026, with four-year topline data due in September.

news.headline: Senvest Management LLC Buys 22,300 Shares of uniQure N.V. $QURE
news.summary: Hedge fund Senvest Management increased its uniQure stake by 44.6% in a recent quarter to 72,300 shares, a minor but illustrative sign of continued institutional accumulation.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to report four-year safety and efficacy topline data (24 patients across the low- and high-dose cohorts, data cut June 30, 2026) from the Phase I/II study in Huntington's disease.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Following written FDA confirmation (July 2026) that 3-year data can support an accelerated-approval filing, uniQure intends to submit the Biologics License Application in Q3 2026, pending final alignment with FDA on the confirmatory (post-approval) study design.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK MHRA MAA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, based on the 3-year Phase I/II data package.

catalysts.label: FDA alignment on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: Ahead of the BLA filing, uniQure must finalize with the FDA the design of the required post-approval confirmatory study, expected to use a randomized standard-of-care control arm with total functional capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 epilepsy second cohort enrollment complete
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second (mid-dose) cohort in the Phase I/IIa GenTLE study of AMT-260 for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.

catalysts.label: Epilepsy (AMT-260) and Fabry disease (AMT-191) program updates
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans further clinical data updates for its AMT-260 epilepsy and AMT-191 Fabry disease gene therapy programs.

pulse: uniQure shares have rebounded to roughly $51 (Aug 25, 2026) from a brief early-August dip near $44, as the stock rebuilds momentum ahead of two major near-term catalysts: four-year AMT-130 topline data due in September and a planned Q3 2026 BLA filing for accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, now that the FDA has confirmed in writing that three-year data can support the application. Q2 2026 results (July 29) showed a strengthened balance sheet — $810.3 million in cash providing runway into 2030 after June's $259 million raise — and sell-side reaction has been mixed but broadly bullish, with Wells Fargo raising its target to $75 even as Barclays trimmed to $60; consensus sits around $65-71 with a Strong Buy/Moderate Buy tilt. The key swing factor now is finalizing the confirmatory post-approval study design with the FDA, which must be resolved before the BLA can actually be submitted.
